reason: Case-control comparison of constitutional BRCA1 promoter methylation in blood DNA from 473 ovarian cancer patients and 476 controls, linking a measured methylation marker to cancer risk stratification.
Case-control comparison of peripheral blood DNA methylation between young men with obesity and normal-weight controls, relating measured methylation to a modifiable exposure.

Retrospective two-group comparison of long- versus short-term glioblastoma survivors in which patient-level MGMT promoter methylation was among the molecular markers entered into the prognostic model, though methylation was abstracted from routine reports rather than being the study focus.
Cross-sectional diagnostic accuracy study of the cytological PAX1/JAM3 methylation assay for CIN3+ detection in 1398 women referred for colposcopy.
Prospective clinical cohort of 155 individuals in which urine DNA methylation at IRF4/PENK/PXDN was measured and used to build a bladder cancer detection classifier.
Diagnostic case-control evaluation of a cfDNA methylation assay in 86 colorectal cancer cases and 130 controls for early detection.

Case-control study of 100 IUGR and 100 AGA pregnancies measuring placental ADIPOQ and LEP DNA methylation, though the link is to disease pathophysiology rather than an explicitly stated clinical decision.
Population-based cohort of 536 cognitively normal adults with genome-wide blood DNA methylation tested as a mediator between the modifiable exposure PM2.5 and CSF Alzheimer biomarkers.
Retrospective cohort of IDH-wildtype astrocytic tumours in which DNA methylation profiling was performed on patient tumours and used for diagnostic classification linked to survival outcomes.
PhenoAge and Klemera-Doubal biological age in this UK Biobank cross-sectional analysis are derived from clinical biomarkers, not from any measured epigenetic marker.
Secondary analysis of a randomised controlled trial in which DNA methylation age was measured before and after nucleotide supplementation, an intervention.
Cohort study of 691 Lifelines-DEEP participants relating dietary intake to blood DNA methylation-based epigenetic clocks.

Multiomic characterisation of 158 human pulmonary nodules with a cfDNA methylation classifier developed and validated for benign versus malignant diagnosis.

Prognostic modelling in TCGA colorectal cohorts with individual-level ATAC-seq chromatin accessibility among the measured layers, but the risk signature itself is expression-based so the marker-to-decision link is indirect.
DNA methylation measured in normal, malignant and aggressive prostate tissue from the same individuals and linked to disease recurrence prediction.
Diagnostic model based on EVX2 methylation measured by MALDI-TOF in cervical exfoliated cells from a retrospective cohort of 104 plus an independent validation cohort, for cancer-risk triage.
Single-centre cohort study measuring cfDNA methylation-based Tumour Methylation Score in 25 cholangiocarcinoma patients and 12 controls for detection, prognosis and monitoring.
DNA methylation profiling was performed in human osteosarcoma samples, but the outcome is pre-analytical assay success rather than a modifiable exposure or a clinical or public health decision.

DNA methylation profiling of meningiomas from 10 DMPA-exposed women with comparison only to external reference cohorts; the abstract does not state an analytic design that can be mapped to one of the five eligible designs.
Case-control study of 120 multiple myeloma patients and 60 controls measuring HOXA5 and NDRG2 promoter methylation for diagnosis and prognosis of renal impairment.
Case-control study of 48 ischaemic stroke patients and 48 controls measuring KLF2 and THBD promoter methylation as a risk marker.
Summary data-based Mendelian randomisation drawing methylation associations from GWAS and mQTL summary statistics, with no individual-level participant data analysed.
Retrospective series of six papillary glioneuronal tumour cases with no comparison group, despite DNA methylation profiling being used for reclassification.
Blood DNA methylation marker model developed in the ESTHER cohort and externally validated in HUNT cohorts for lung cancer risk prediction.

Retrospective multicentre cohort with paired DNA methylation and H&E images, using measured methylation-based molecular class and methylation-derived progression-free survival risk group as the clinical classification and prognostic targets.
H3K27 acetylation was measured in mouse models and in vitro fibroblasts; the human stroke cohort contributed only vitamin B12 status and clinical outcomes.
Retrospective institutional review in which 72 gliomas underwent methylation profiling and three hemispheric cases are described, but the abstract states no comparison, grouping or analytic design.
Brain age is estimated from T1w/T2w ratio MRI, not from DNA methylation or any other epigenetic marker.
Prognostic risk model built from individual-level DNA methylation and expression profiles in public glioma cohorts and validated in external cohorts for survival stratification.
Plasma extrachromosomal circular DNA is a structural genomic feature, not DNA methylation, histone modification, chromatin state or an epigenetic clock.

KDM and PhenoAge biological age in this UK Biobank cohort are computed from clinical biomarkers, with no epigenetic marker measured.
Histone modification appears only as a functional annotation of a transcriptomic gene subtype; the study measures RNA expression and genetic variants, not epigenetic marks.

Nested case-control study of 134 colorectal cancer patients in which genome-wide blood DNA methylation was measured and used via methylation cytometry to derive leukocyte subsets related to survival, though methylation serves mainly as a deconvolution substrate.
Study protocol describing planned recruitment and planned DNA methylation profiling, with no results reported.
Germline whole-genome sequencing study reporting sequence and structural variants only, with no epigenetic marker measured.
Two-sample Mendelian randomisation using publicly available GWAS summary statistics with no individual-level data analysed.
Two prospective cohorts totalling 3688 individuals with blood DNA methylation at 767,735 CpG sites related to atherosclerosis, cardiovascular risk factors including smoking, and incident events.

Case-control GWAS and polygenic risk score analysis; methylation enters only through external East Asian mQTL summary data, with no epigenetic marker measured in participants.
Chromatin-regulator gene mutations and flow-cytometry immune markers were measured, but no epigenetic mark such as methylation or histone modification was assayed.

Cohort of 37 pancreatic cancer patients with LINE-1 and SATa hypomethylation measured in tumour DNA and related to prognosis alongside ctDNA status.
